title: Weights Harbor: end-to-end import, format harmonization, deterministic smoke and runtime profiling publish
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a resilient end-to-end pipeline (Weights Harbor) that: 1) accepts community-supplied model weights from multiple sources, 2) converts and normalizes storage and tensor formats into our canonical runtime artifact, 3) runs deterministic smoke checks and microbench profiling (latency, memory, KV cache behavior), and 4) publishes a versioned performance profile and canonical pin to the model catalog. This ticket focuses on orchestration, conversion adapters, deterministic validator, lightweight microbench harness, artifact provenance metadata, and publishing hooks for the catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Weights Harbor can ingest artifacts from HuggingFace, S3 signed URLs, and OCI registries via a pluggable adapter
Conversion adapters output a canonical artifact compatible with runtime-1.22 without manual intervention
Deterministic smoke run must pass identical token outputs on repeated runs (seeded) for the same model and sample set
Microbench produces latency P50/P95, peak GPU memory, and KV cache reuse ratio and stores these metrics as a performance profile
Published catalog entry includes pin, artifact checksum, provenance URL, topology metadata, and performance profile
End-to-end pipeline completes within expected SLAs (soft target: 30m for 7B-class models on standard conversion host)
steps: Design adapter interface and implement 3 initial adapters: HF hub, signed S3, OCI
Implement format harmonizer to convert: PyTorch state_dict, safetensors, and sharded checkpoints into canonical runtime artifact
Add deterministic smoke harness: fixed seed sampling, prompt set (50 canonical prompts), and output diff checks
Implement microbench harness: token-level throughput, P50/P95 latency, peak memory, KV cache hit profiling
Integrate artifact provenance metadata capture (uploader, source URL, checksum, conversion logs)
Publish to model catalog with schema v2: pin, profiles, and selectable runtime compatibility tags
Add telemetry and alerting for conversion failures, deterministic drift, and profiling regression compared to baseline
